A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same BioAgent Bench study with readable text, figures, tables, and complete Appendices A.1–A.8. The appendix content matches after accounting for shifted pagination.

before.justification: v1 reports original model-and-harness evaluations, planning scores, repeated-trial stability measurements, and perturbation outcomes in Section 6 and the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains the original empirical evaluations and results from v1, including completion rates, stability measurements, and perturbation outcomes.

M1.justification: The benchmark execution procedure, agent harnesses, GPT-5.1 grader, and system and grading prompts remain unchanged in Sections 4–5 and Appendices A.1–A.4.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same ten bioinformatics tasks listed in Table 1, with identical dataset descriptions and prompt-bloat, corruption, and decoy scenarios.

E2.justification: The model and harness comparator entries in Figures 2–3 and Appendix A.5, Table 4, are identical. No comparison method is added or removed.

E3.justification: Sections 5–6 retain the same harness configurations, resource constraints, completion scoring, planning evaluation, stability metrics, and perturbation procedures.

E4.justification: The planning analysis, repeated-trial robustness analysis, perturbation failure analyses, and Salmon configuration case study in Appendix A.7 are retained without revision.

E5.justification: Section 6.1 and Table 2 retain the same trial counts, and Section 6.2 retains one trial per task and perturbation condition. No uncertainty-reporting or statistical-estimation practice changes.

E6.justification: Numerical entries and qualitative findings are identical throughout the results and appendices. For example, Table 4 retains Claude Opus 4.5's 100% Codex CLI completion rate, and Section 6.1 retains mean Jaccard and Pearson values of 0.43 and 0.73.

T1.justification: The Jaccard-index definition and correlation calculation in Section 6.1 are unchanged. Neither version contains formal theorems or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same benchmark and evaluation-suite contributions, high frontier-agent completion claims, and qualifications about fragile step-level reasoning.

C2.justification: Interpretations of planning quality, run variability, perturbation failures, and privacy-related applicability are unchanged. Section 8 retains the same limitations concerning LLM grading, benchmark coverage, and robustness sampling.

D1.justification: The implementation and resource details, system/task/grader prompts, perturbation recipes, and code/data access information are identical. The new funding acknowledgment adds no technical or reproducibility information.

R1.justification: Section 2 and all cited works remain unchanged. The reference list is repaginated without additions, removals, or changes in research positioning.

P1.justification: v2 adds a short Acknowledgments section between the Impact Statement and References, disclosing EU NextGenerationEU funding and Croatian Science Foundation support. The arXiv version/date stamp changes; the remaining prose and section order are unchanged.

P2.justification: The acknowledgment shifts the references, leaving the final reference continuation on a nearly empty page 11 and moving the appendix start from page 11 to page 12. Figures, tables, captions, and appendix layouts otherwise remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The added funding acknowledgment modestly improves disclosure, with minor reference-pagination effects. The scientific argument, empirical evidence, limitations, and reproducibility material are identical, so this administrative update produces no meaningful overall quality difference.
